name: RestoreBackup
transaction_boundary: cryptographic/database verification completes in isolated staging before quiesce; current live database is first preserved as verified emergency recovery copy; replacement uses LLD-01 atomic recovery choreography and is rolled back if restored-open/integrity/audit finalization fails
authoritative_reads: exact artifact digest and preview fingerprint
guards: staged SQLCipher DB passes schema/migration/FK/audit checks
idempotency: COMMAND_ENVELOPE_V1 plus restore operation identity; committed restored data_instance_id prevents duplicate replacement
receipt_order: preflight outside UoW -> acquire exclusive recovery state -> emergency backup -> verify again -> replace -> open/verify restored DB -> insert command_receipt + security.backup_restored audit in restored DB -> commit -> remove recovery marker
rules: no live mutation before complete verification
failed finalization restores prior verified database
portable source DPAPI state is never required because encrypted payload carries source live DEK
